_comment: Data for core helpers/start-report-gate.cjs. order_patterns: the operator's FIRST message counts as an explicit order for work when one of these matches - then the work may start at once (the start report still comes with the first closing reply, open-items-gate). effect_patterns: a Bash command that acts OUTSIDE this machine or cannot be undone (merge, push, post, comment, release, delete) - denied in the first turn without an order; local edits pass. Case-insensitive JavaScript regex. Add the instance's language to order_patterns; measure with node core/helpers/start-report-gate.cjs --replay <transcripts>.
